english_question: How can I improve soil health with compost in Ikeja, Alausa/Oregun/Olusosun, Ikeja, Lagos, Nigeria?

This helps speed up the decomposition process and prevents odors. 4. **Time:** Depending on the materials and conditions, your compost should be ready in about 3 to 6 months. You'll know it's ready when it looks dark and crumbly and has an earthy smell. Once your compost is ready, you can apply it to your soil. Spread a layer of compost about 2-3 inches thick over your garden beds and mix it into the top few inches of soil. This will improve soil structure, increase nutrient content, and enhance water retention, which is particularly beneficial during the dry season.
